description: EPE - GASODUTOS DE TRANSPORTE - ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localizações aproximadas e as principais características técnicas dos dutos de transporte de gás natural de acordo com as publicações da EPE, da ANP e de empresas que atuam no setor de gás natural. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are DUTOS, ENERGIA, EPE, epe_gasodutos_de_transporte, ES. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
